concepts.title: Ratio and Proportion
concepts.definition: A mathematical comparison of two quantities of the same kind to determine how many times one value contains another.
question_patterns: find the ratio of {quantity_a} to {quantity_b}
calculate the ratio between two speeds
what is the ratio of {item_1} to {item_2}
express the comparison as a ratio
Find the ratio of 60 km to 4 hours.
Boys to girls are 20 to 15 -- write the ratio.

solution_steps.explain: The ratio is found by dividing the first quantity by the second.

concepts.title: Percentage Conversion
concepts.definition: Representing a fraction or a ratio as a part of 100 to simplify comparisons.
concepts.key_idea: Converting a fraction to a base of 100.
question_patterns: express the ratio {a}:{b} as a percentage of the whole mix
convert the ratio {a}:{b} to percentage
what percent of {total} is {part}
calculate the percentage of students interested in a subject
find the percentage of the total distance covered
State 9/25 as a percent.
Out of 40 matches, 15 were wins -- win percentage?

solution_steps.explain: Divide the part by the total to get the fractional value.
Multiply the fraction by 100 to get the percentage.

concepts.title: Discount and Sale Price
concepts.definition: The slice cut from the list price; what remains to pay is the sale price.
concepts.key_idea: List price minus the cut equals what you actually pay.
question_patterns: find the discount granted on a festival-sale item marked at {marked_price}
find the discount on an item marked at {marked_price}
calculate the sale price after a discount of {discount_percent}
what is the discount amount
how much is the reduction on the list price
List price 850 with a 85 cut -- what do you pay?

solution_steps.explain: Multiply the marked price by the discount percentage rate.
The sale price is the marked price minus the discount amount.

concepts.title: Discount Percentage
concepts.definition: The rate of discount calculated as a percentage of the marked price.
concepts.key_idea: Expressing the price reduction relative to the original marked price.
question_patterns: find the discount percent
calculate the rate of discount
what percentage reduction was given on the marked price
determine the discount % if MP is {marked_price} and SP is {sale_price}
MP 900, SP 810 -- find the percent off.

solution_steps.explain: Subtract sale price from marked price to find the absolute discount.
Divide the discount by the marked price and multiply by 100.

concepts.title: Sales Tax and GST
concepts.definition: Government charges added on a sale show up on your bill on top of the item's price.
concepts.key_idea: The charge is worked out from the selling price, then tacked on.
question_patterns: find the bill amount including GST
calculate the total price after adding sales tax
how much tax is paid on an item costing {price}
what is the final amount to be paid including {tax_rate}% tax
A 1200 shirt carries 5 percent tax -- what is the bill?

solution_steps.explain: Find the tax by applying the tax rate to the original price.
The total bill is the sum of the original price and the tax amount.

concepts.title: Price Before Tax
concepts.definition: Given the bill total with tax, undo the addition to recover the sticker price.
concepts.key_idea: Reversing the tax addition to find the base price.
question_patterns: find the price before VAT was added
calculate the original price before GST
what was the price of the article before tax
determine the cost excluding {tax_rate}% tax
The taxed bill is 1260 at 5 percent -- what was the sticker price?

solution_steps.explain: The total price represents 100% plus the tax percentage.
Divide the total price by the total percentage factor and multiply by 100.

concepts.title: Compound Interest Formula
concepts.definition: Each period's charge is worked out on a growing balance: the deposited sum plus everything gathered so far.
concepts.key_idea: Interest on interest leads to exponential growth.
question_patterns: find the compound interest on {principal}
calculate the amount after {time} years at {rate}% compounded annually
what is the CI for a sum of {principal}
determine the final amount using the CI formula
Find the amount on 8000 at 5 percent for 2 years, compounded yearly.

solution_steps.explain: Use the formula A = P(1 + R/100)^n to find the total amount.
Subtract the principal from the total amount to find the compound interest.

concepts.title: Appreciation and Growth
concepts.definition: Growth that compounds: each year's rise joins the base, so the whole scales by (1 + rate/100) every year.
concepts.key_idea: Population growth follows the same mathematical model as compound interest.
question_patterns: find the population after {time} years
calculate the bacteria count after {time} hours
what will be the population if it increases at {growth_rate}% p.a.
estimate the growth of a city's population
A town of 25000 grows 4 percent yearly -- size after 2 years?

solution_steps.explain: Use the compounding formula with the initial value and growth rate.

concepts.title: Depreciation
concepts.definition: The reduction in the value of an asset over time due to usage, age, or wear and tear.
concepts.key_idea: Value decreases exponentially using a negative growth rate in the CI formula.
question_patterns: find the value of a machine after depreciation
calculate the price of a vehicle after {time} years of use
what is the depreciated value of the item
find the value if it decreases at {decay_rate}% per annum
A scooter bought at 40000 sheds 8 percent yearly -- value after 1 year?

solution_steps.explain: Use the compounding formula with a subtraction for the decay rate.
